name: Experience Forever Reboot
teaser: Get rid of skill fatigue completely and always level all skills.
description_html:
I rewrote the original Experience Forever since it was using guessed values at the skill.

Mod Features

1. You have the option to select Use Original Metabolism since that scales wierdly with no skill fatigue… or you can leave that as false in the bepinex config menu.

2. Set your own multiplier for metabolism if you feel it increases too quickly or slowly.

3. Set multiplier if you would like to level more quickly for all skills (other than metabolism).

Installation

Put into your bepinex/plugins folder.
